product_name: Samsung Galaxy F36 5G (Black, 128 GB) (8 GB RAM)
description: Stunning Visuals: Enjoy a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate and Gorilla Glass Victus+ for smooth, vivid viewing and extra durability. Smooth Performance: Powered by the Exynos 1380 processor with 8 GB RAM and 128 GB storage, perfect for multitasking, gaming, and daily tasks. Versatile Camera Setup: Capture every moment with a 50 MP main camera with OIS, an 8 MP ultra-wide, 2 MP macro, and a 13 MP front camera for great selfies. Long Battery Life: Equipped with a 5000 mAh battery and 25W fast charging, giving you all-day power with quick top-ups. Smart & Secure: Runs on Android 15 with One UI 7, includes AI-powered tools like Object Eraser, and offers 6 years of software & security updates.
